fields.Address: 3000 Hwy 17 Bypass S, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: One of the area's largest water parks, open since 1985. Seasonal.
fields.Name: Myrtle Waves Water Park
fields.Hours Note: Seasonal water park; check the park calendar for open days.

fields.Short Description: Oceanfront rides since 1966, with the Splashes Oceanfront Water Park on the same grounds.
fields.Name: Family Kingdom Amusement Park
fields.Hours Note: Closed for the season; the 2026 season has ended. Check the 2027 calendar or call (843) 626-3447.

fields.Address: 301 S Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Parasailing from the Myrtle Beach oceanfront. A second location is at 2985 S Ocean Blvd.
fields.Name: Downwind Sails Parasailing

fields.Short Description: Ziplines, aerial tours and ropes courses at the south end of Myrtle Beach. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays in the off-season; check the website for hours.
fields.Name: Radical Ropes Adventure Park
fields.Hours Note: Fall hours: Wed–Fri noon–10 PM, Sat–Sun 10 AM–10 PM, closed Mon–Tue. Last aerial tour 7 PM, last zip tour 8 PM.

fields.Short Description: Wakeboard, kneeboard or water-ski behind a cable instead of a boat, no gear or experience needed, or bounce around a floating inflatable obstacle course. It's on the lake at the North Myrtle Beach Park & Sports Complex.
fields.Name: Shark Wake Park
fields.Hours Note: Seasonal: weekends in spring and fall, daily in summer; hours vary, so call ahead

fields.Short Description: Guided horseback rides on an undeveloped island beach, including sunset rides, plus waterway trail rides and short pony rides for little ones. Rides run year round.
fields.Name: Inlet Point Plantation

fields.Short Description: Seven go-kart tracks including a pro track and a kids' track, plus bumper cars, kiddie rides and an arcade.
fields.Name: Broadway Grand Prix
fields.Price: All-you-can-ride wristbands $54.99 (48" and up) or $44.99 (40–48"), $5 less online; toddler band $14.99
fields.Hours Note: Hours change by date and season (typically late morning to evening). Check the park calendar before you go.

fields.Short Description: Retro rides carrying on the old Myrtle Beach Pavilion's heritage, in the Broadway at the Beach complex.
fields.Name: Pavilion Nostalgia Park

fields.Address: Broadway at the Beach, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A 1,000-foot zipline over Lake Broadway and a ropes obstacle course.
fields.Name: Soar & Explore (WonderWorks)
fields.Hours Note: Closed for the season (fall 2026). WonderWorks itself stays open.

fields.Short Description: Parasailing, jet skis, kayak and paddleboard rentals and dolphin cruises from Murrells Inlet.
fields.Name: Express Watersports
fields.Hours Note: Office open Mon–Sat 10 AM–5 PM. Parasailing and jet skis run on a seasonal schedule; book online.

fields.Short Description: Jet ski rentals from Cricket Cove Marina in Little River.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Jet Ski Rental

fields.Address: North Myrtle Beach Sports and Recreation Park, North Myrtle Beach, SC
fields.Short Description: A treetop obstacle course with 600 and 900-foot ziplines over a lake. Status needs confirming.
fields.Name: Go Ape Treetop Adventure

fields.Address: 1110 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A Ferris wheel above the oceanfront with views of the whole Strand.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach SkyWheel

fields.Short Description: MarshWalk marina with jet skis, banana boat rides, dolphin cruises and sunset sails.
fields.Name: Crazy Sister Marina
fields.Hours Note: Fishing trips, jet skis and cruises run on a seasonal schedule. Book online or call (843) 651-3676.

fields.Address: 1525 13th Ave N, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Rent jet skis for the waterway, backwater or ocean, join a 2-hour jet ski dolphin excursion, or take a pontoon out for a half or full day on the Intracoastal.
fields.Name: Action Water Sportz

fields.Address: 2349 Dick Pond Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29575
fields.Short Description: Indoor and outdoor speed-kart racing with roller skating, bowling, laser tag, inflatables and an arcade of 50+ games.
fields.Name: Fun Warehouse

fields.Address: 9589 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Short Description: Two elevated tracks, the Mighty Myrtle and the Wild Woody, plus a rookie track, carousel, blaster boats and arcade.
fields.Name: The Track Family Fun Park
fields.Price: Pay-as-you-go point cards: 60 points $55, 125 points $110, 250 points $215
fields.Hours Note: Hours change with the season; call ahead.

fields.Address: Harbourgate Marina, 2100 Sea Mountain Hwy, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Guided jet ski dolphin tours from Harbourgate Marina.
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Watersports

fields.Short Description: Twin five-story towers joined by a 600-foot racing zipline, with a ropes course and 50-foot freefall. Address and current status need confirming.
fields.Name: Adrenaline Adventure Zipline

fields.Address: 720 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: A fully enclosed indoor track with fast electric karts, plus an arcade and pool tables.
fields.Name: K1 Speed
